report_text: Creative Fatigue Report — Over the last 60 days, 255 ads were analyzed. The account shows a moderate fatigue posture with 175 ads to KEEP, 78 on WATCH for early fatigue signs, 2 recommended for REFRESH, and none flagged for ROTATE or ACT NOW. This indicates most ads are performing steadily, but a few are showing clear signs of decline and need attention soon. Top 3 to replace first: 1) Ad_007/8/11_BOF(ATC_And_Cart_Visitors_30_Days)_NSM_SS26_Flat20%_Catalog_6May (REFRESH, fatigue score 0.4511) is fatigued due to a 34% drop in CTR and an 18.75% decline in ROAS, alongside a 4.3% increase in CPA. Audience saturation is very high, limiting reach and engagement. The ad’s performance trend is deteriorating with significant CTR decay, indicating creative wear-out. 2) Ad_019/105/1_Broad_Top-Metro-Cities_Creatives_Static-1_29May (REFRESH, fatigue score 0.4118) shows a 47.7% ROAS decline and a 110% increase in CPA, with purchase conversion rate dropping nearly 46%. Audience saturation is moderate but impacting efficiency. These KPI deteriorations signal the ad is losing effectiveness in driving sales. Both ads have been in market over a month and should be refreshed within 14 days to restore performance. No ads currently require immediate rotation or action, but ongoing monitoring of WATCH ads is recommended to catch early fatigue signs.
